dslRule:
/*!id: jface.text.ICharacterPairMatcher.match.signature
<!description: Update ICharacterPairMatcher.match() signature to use separate offset and length parameters, improving selection handling.
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: api-migration, jface>
*/
$matcher.match($document, $region.getOffset() + $region.getLength()) :: instanceof($region, "org.eclipse.jface.text.IRegion") && instanceof($matcher, "org.eclipse.jface.text.source.ICharacterPairMatcher")
=>
$matcher.match($document, $region.getOffset(), $region.getLength())
;;
summary: Refactor ICharacterPairMatcher.match() calls to use separate offset and length parameters, aligning with a new API signature for improved handling of text selections.
